::: {#exr-irls-step}

#### One IRLS step for the six-patient trial

In the [six-patient trial](#exm-logistic-regression), start from $\vcoef^* = \vzero$.

1.  Find the fitted [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability), the weights and the working responses.
2.  Compute $\qform{W}{X}$ and $\tp{X} W \vecf{z}$.
3.  Compute the updated coefficients $\inv{\paren{\qform{W}{X}}} \tp{X} W \vecf{z}$.

:::
